title: paykit
summary: A local Go CLI that emits correctly-signed webhooks for Indian payment gateways (Razorpay, Cashfree) and replays adversarial cases — duplicate delivery, reordering, corrupted signatures — so integrations stop being tested by hand through a tunnel. Signatures verified against the official provider SDKs. Explicitly not a hosted service and never calls a real payment API.
